items.q: Can I order my whole month's ration?
items.a: Yes. Send the full list once; we pack it together and can repeat it every month.

items.q: Is there a minimum order for delivery?
items.a: Small orders are also fine nearby; for farther areas message us and we will tell you.

items.q: What if an item is damaged or expired?
items.a: Bring it back with the bill and we replace it; we check dates before packing.
We stock the brands people ask for; message us the item and we will check or arrange it.

items.q: Do you do recharge and bill payments?
items.a: Yes, mobile recharge, DTH and some bill payments are done at the counter.
Cash, UPI and cards at the shop; UPI for WhatsApp orders and delivery.
